title: fix(desktop): show the shared pink countdown on Frame recordings
body:
## Problem
Recording from Frame mode (area picked on the capture overlay) showed a white countdown; the Record page path shows the pink one.

## Cause
Two separate countdowns existed:
- `CountdownOverlay` (Record page): pink number, own CSS module, Cancel button, Esc listener.
- `RecordingShade` (the click-through shade window used for Frame/area recordings): its own markup and `.countdown*` CSS with a white `#fff` number.

## Change
- `RecordingShade` now renders the shared `CountdownOverlay`; its duplicate markup and `.countdown*` styles are deleted.
- `CountdownOverlay` gains optional props: `region` (confine and border it to the area, dim the rest), `hint` (shown instead of the Cancel button), and `onCancel` is now optional. Without `onCancel` it renders no Cancel button and registers no key listener, because the shade is click-through and unfocusable.
- Esc is unchanged: it is still the hub's global shortcut (`holdTemporaryShortcut`, commit 86b9aa82), which the shade never handled.
- Behaviour note: after the last tick the shade now shows the shared spinner (as the Record page does) instead of an empty dimmed region.

## Verification
- `check-types`, `lint` (0 errors), and the full app test suite (2555 tests) pass.
- New tests: the shade's countdown is the shared overlay (status role, region geometry, no Cancel button), its number uses the same class as `CountdownOverlay`, and the overlay without `onCancel` has no button.

## Not verified
Not run visually in the real app. Please check on a Frame recording: pink number centered in the area, blur/dim look over a transparent window, region border, spinner handoff, and Esc cancel.
